pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
Thesis on $BASKET:
As a new trader I’ve come to understand there are mainly two different types of trading. One is pure extraction—performative “community,” diamond-hands talk, then hostility and dumping that leaves everyone else with less. The other is the real version: a good community built on trust. This is the trust game. When investing/trading the asset is something everyone shares in, not a race to extract the largest possible amount of money. When it goes red you don’t panic and full-dump everything you’ve put in. You hold your position, stay level, and let the group work through it together so everyone gets a share of the upside over time.- That is if there is an upside. 
Am I willing to hold my $BASKET and find out, loss or gain?
Yes, I am.

comment.comment:
Despite the legitimate concerns and FUD surrounding $BASKET, I don’t think people should overlook what it’s actually trying to build.

The underlying concept is solid. A launchpad combining tokenized stocks, holder rewards, buybacks and burns, and the ability to create your own baskets has genuine potential. The concerns surrounding wallets, distribution, and unanswered questions deserve attention, but they don’t automatically invalidate the product itself.

And let’s be honest: the resemblance to $FLOAT is hard to ignore. Whether intentional or not, that similarity alone is enough to attract attention from the same crowd that made FLOAT run. If anything, I think we’re potentially looking at a vamp style attention play.

I’m not saying the FUD is baseless, or that $BASKET is affiliated with FLOAT. I’m saying there’s a difference between legitimate concerns about a project and writing off the entire concept before it has a chance to develop.

The narrative is there. The concept is there. Now it’s about execution. 🧺
